Same question as receipts[11]: if MFO is state aid, the detail category should be other state aid.

issues.on_page: Charges for services 11,171 (p2 Statement of Activities labels this 'Electric, gas, and cable lease')
issues.issue: p2 shows this is electric/gas/cable lease or franchise money. Rentals or occupation/franchise tax may fit better than charges for services.
The notes say mixed lines take the dominant fund type, but business-type is the larger share of this line (11,010 vs 7,974).
Per p6 the transfer out comes from the Electric fund (business-type); the Transfers In side goes to the General fund (governmental).

Under its 'Taxes' heading p4 itemizes this line (lines sum to 124,038, 1 dollar short). About 70,000 of it is not tax: State Highway Allocation 60,806, Homestead, State Tax Credit, Pro Rate. Keeping it unsplit is defensible because of the 1 dollar gap, but the category overstates taxes.
